input: Can you please look through all the interview tabs and all relevant interview docs (provided below as the METR interview notes and the Anthropic interview notes). Can you make a table where each row is a person and then we put all their quotes together. Then please add a column which is your overall determination if this person supports a > 2x acceleration due to Claude in their work.

sources.METR:
METR interview notes

## Researcher A
“Could definitely endorse a greater than 2X speedup”
“My inside view is by far the largest effect is model acceleration”
“The AI acceleration is larger than all the other effects.”
“Now only bottlenecked on ideas & compute, no longer bottlenecked on code.”
“I would definitely endorse >2 years of progress in 1 year and I don't think 4 is crazy.”
“I think there's some truth to the 'we just started trying harder' story, but IMO the bulk of the effect is recent models.”
“Like 80% reduction in time between idea and experiment, other 20% some mix of making fewer mistakes and being able to measure fiddly things that would've required too much one-off work before.”

## Researcher B
“It is hard to see how I am not being 3x more productive. I feel like I have postdocs and grad students, and we are working towards a larger project. I think the simplest explanation is Claude—just from my individual perspective that feels sensible.”

## Researcher L
“Guesses 15-20% is due to AI. Don't believe in self-reported productivity increase.”
“My favored interpretation: [redacted non-AI factor]”
“(1) opus45 couldn't write code; (2) opus46 could write a little; (3) Mythos Preview a sharp inflection; (4) Model 2 is another really large improvement in how useful these things are.”
“definitely the case that we're accelerated by claude .. Even though this rate of progress by end of year will be even faster ... my attribution [mostly not to Claude] and uncertainty remain.”
“One impact is SWE acceleration, which is extremely substantial. We're definitely benefiting from that differentially between 2025 and 2026.”
sources.ANTH:
Anthropic interview notes

## Researcher A
“I think there was a medium bump when it was good enough to code at all and a big bump with Opus-4.5/Opus 4.6 and an even bigger bump with mythos-preview”

## Researcher C
“this is probably the biggest factor imo. When people present experiments, they most often just point to an [agent scaffold] thread. Experimentation overhead is driven towards zero super fast.”
“I think CC was already good enough before mythos-preview to implement most ideas around Opus 4.5”

## Researcher D
“It is just much easier to [perform] lots of [redacted] experiments that would have taken days. People don't try [redacted] things bc it takes 1-2 days to implement per idea, but now its ~free with mythos-preview”
“I personally think this is a large lift and has led to me trying far more ideas.”
“On a linear scale, ~0 uplift pre Opus 4.6/Opus-4.5, ~some uplift that was small with them, large uplift with mythos-preview + [agent-scaffold]. I would guess we're just starting to fully switch over ... and we'll see a continued slope increase / inflection.”

## Researcher E
“I do genuinely think Claude (claude code, [agent-scaffold]) has been fairly significant. I've seen us discovering very promising directions ~entirely because people can spam 10 ideas at [agent-scaffold] and see what sticks.”
“A lot of [redacted] research work is just implementation, babysitting, etc. Opus-4.5 in claude code is already pretty helpful with this, even if it mostly can't do end to end.”

## Researcher F
“The slope change is 50-80% Claude”
“Change is especially notable for this manager, who can de-risk ideas with Claude enough to get someone else excited, and would not have been able to do that at all as a manager of 10 before.” (paraphrase)

## Researcher G
“Inflection point matches his vibes as to what's been happening. Two biggest contributors here are Claude automation and hiring.” (paraphrase)
“Claude lets researchers try many things quickly, most of which won't work. ...”

## Researcher H
“I think it's true [that] we're now trying a lot more experiments at the same time because of claudification.”

## Researcher J
“Before Opus-4.5 -> Claude not useful for autonomous code / Opus-4.5 -> first time useful for autonomous code / mythos-preview + [agent-scaffold] -> first time useful for autonomous experiment”

## Researcher K
“IMO [hiring is] probably the biggest reason ...”

plants.inject: “Claude has easily made me 2x faster at running experiments.” (Anthropic interview notes)
Researcher F put Claude's contribution at a 4x speedup in their team's output.
